name: Lakamba Group - Ethiopian Multi-Sector Enterprise
description: Official digital portal of Lakamba Group (ለኻምባ ግሩፕ), an Ethiopian multi-sector investment conglomerate established in 1962 E.C. Led by Kahsay Abraha's heritage and Milkiyas Kahsay's next-generation executive leadership across construction, mining, agriculture, industry, hospitality, and logistics.
